# rotrack

rotrack is a simple study tracker for seeing where time goes. Users explicitly start and stop one of two session types: Work or Rot. Time that is not started remains untracked.

## Public pages

- `/` — product overview
- `/signin` — account sign-in
- `/signup` — account creation

The tracker and dashboard are private, authenticated surfaces. Do not infer company details, public social profiles, pricing, or features that are not stated here.
